The undershoot misses by 12 mV (0.242 V against 0.23 V), and every other spec passes. That is a small margin, so I'll refine the parameters rather than edit the program. Iq is the tightest constraint (50.1 µA against 51 µA), so this run moves current out of the divider and toward loop speed.

{"action": "refine", "reason": "Only undershoot fails, by 12 mV. Steer the search toward larger Cc (more vout-to-gate coupling), lower ratio_h/ratio_l (faster GBW) and slightly smaller Idiv to keep Iq under 51 uA. Topology works, so tuning parameters inside their bounds is the cheap fix.", "params": {"Cc": 70e-12, "ratio_h": 2.0, "ratio_l": 1.8, "Idiv": 28e-6, "gmid_p": 14.0}, "bounds": {"Cc": [30e-12, 120e-12], "ratio_h": [1.5, 3.5], "ratio_l": [1.4, 3.0], "Idiv": [15e-6, 34e-6]}}
